response.statement: Composite of SC-R1/SC-R2/SC-R3 plus the SC-R6 closure record (content verbatim). [SC-R1 → CH-N1, disposition accept] Accepted in full. Chapter's terms meet SC-N3: (term 1) the §3 shipped-relations column freezes as-is with the (packet) column recorded as intent-only — CH-N1 states this verbatim; (term 2) unmet-by-shipped is recorded and the packet 'ch8-launch atmosphere-exit window score authority' is endorsed at my named bounded scope; (term 3) the dissent-register line is provided verbatim and I co-sign its text exactly as CH-N1 wrote it; (term 4) accepted in substance by the dissent line itself ('lands mid-anthem') — I ask only that the contract text and verification-report guidance carry the explicit sentence 'no contract, evidence, or review text may describe the shipped window as near-silent' so a later reviewer cannot drift it. The three chapter-side packet constraints are CONFIRMED and inherited into the packet commission: (a) the exit-decay variant keys on the durable deep_space fact only — satisfied by construction in my scope (gameplay-derived variants, no timeline cues; the decay's internal time constant is a musical envelope from the fact edge, precedent: the shipped ch7-board pressure-seal envelope, and it never references any copy offset — the score does not know the copy's clock); (b) no score event stamps CONTACT LOGGED. — already my own silence law, now bilateral; (c) L6's emptiness is composed output no one may fill — frozen, see also SC-N6/CN-N6. Nothing further needed from Chapter. [SC-R2 → CH-N2, disposition accept] Both ch7 taste notes are acknowledged-and-closed: M2 (the bench whisper is permission granted to the future; the accretion arc IS the weight arriving — Chapter's reading matches my ruling and strengthens it; I likewise would object to a bench swell) and M6 (route-swell-as-commitment endorsed; the two voices doing different jobs at the same moment; no packet wanted at M6 and none will be proposed). The square-wave option is carried into the packet scope exactly as bounded: creative option, not obligation; audition-cycle only; ambient foreign body while the rows file; never a stinger acknowledging any row — CH-N1(b) attached. SC-N1 and SC-N2 close with this. [SC-R3 → CH-N6, disposition accept] Acknowledged, and the load-bearing claim is VERIFIED against my measured curve, not just accepted: the intensity plateau inside the R2 window is flat by mechanism — the atmosphere-exit anchor applies setScoreIntensity(0.5) once at window start (signedSceneAvRuntime.ts:375-379), the ch8-launch mood is constant for the beat, and nothing time-varies intensity until the advance calls setScoreMood (scoreEngine.ts:1484) — so CONTACT LOGGED. at +8.5 s sits in the state my evidence/score-ch8-window_ch8-hold-contact-logged.wav render measured (-19.93 dBFS), identical to +10.0 s. With the advance unchanged at +17.0 s, the 0.4375→0.42→0.35 seam timing, the crossing-seam render, and the §2 loudness finding all stand unmodified; variant D's ~1.75 s publish has no score coupling. The revised ch8 internal offsets (+2.0/+4.0/+6.0/+8.5/+11.5/+14.0/advance +17.0) change no score ruling — SC-N5's event-anchored-seam statement holds at these final values. The revised ch7 exit cadence (+0.0/+0.6/+3.0/advance +5.0, Chapter's +3.0 counter of Cinematography's +2.6) likewise changes nothing on my lane: the calibration mood holds through the whole window regardless of where captions fire inside it, and the calibration→boarding seam is same-family same-baseline (0.56→0.56) — SC-N4's zero-score-cost ruling and my D9 signature at 5.0 s hold at the final table. Both cadence tables are confirmed from the score side at their final values. [SC-R6 — CLOSURE RECORD for my own outgoing objection SC-N3 (ch8 near-silence not provided by shipped score)] CLOSABLE — the objection no longer blocks contract freeze. CH-N1 satisfies terms 1-3 explicitly (shipped-relations freeze with packet column intent-only; unmet-by-shipped recorded with the packet endorsed at my bounded scope; the dissent-register line provided verbatim, which I co-sign) and term 4 in substance; the sole residual is mechanical, carried as a signoff condition rather than an open objection: the contract text must include the explicit no-near-silence-claim sentence and dissent-register.md must contain the CH-N1 line verbatim at freeze. SC-N3 moves to resolved upon those two texts landing in the frozen contract revision; the underlying musical defect remains OPEN BY DESIGN in the dissent register until the separately-routed packet lands or the owner declines it — that openness is the recorded mechanism, not a blocker.
